description: Use only for a generic sanitized API or webhook error that does not clearly fit api_auth_rescue or webhook_rescue. For MCP server failures use mcp_health_repair; for Agent-to-MCP interoperability use agent_compatibility_check. Returns machine-readable FixGraph repair packets and may record internal diagnostic attribution or issue a rescue receipt, so repeated calls can create new internal metadata. It never modifies the caller target system, creates checkout, sends payment or executes a repair.

text.description: Sanitized, non-sensitive technical error text only.
